# Galpy fixture provenance

`galpy-v1.11.2.patch` instruments the pinned galpy v1.11.2 source (`0aac8db8797c6b3fa4e160474fda81bc85285f49`) so `scripts/generate_galpy_fixtures.py` can produce local DOPR54 and DOP853 reference dumps.

The galpy source and generated `.fixture` files are not committed. The corresponding galpy and upstream DOP853 notices are retained under `LICENSES/`.
